question: Should plugin approval cancellation become a public nullable `plugin.approval.resolved` contract that every abort-aware plugin approval waiter must use before this PR merges?
rationale: The code direction is plausible, but it changes the gateway/plugin SDK contract and leaves open whether maintainers want a complete public cancel contract now or a narrower internal repair.

options.title: Complete Public Cancel Contract
options.body: Require sibling waiter coverage, protocol/plugin docs, contract tests, conflict refresh, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Narrow Before-Tool-Call Repair
options.body: Land only the current path knowingly, but keep the linked issue or a follow-up open for other approval requesters and SDK docs.

options.title: Pause The API Change
options.body: Hold or close this PR until maintainers decide whether nullable resolved events are the permanent cancellation model.

recommendation.title: Complete Public Cancel Contract
recommendation.body: Require sibling waiter coverage, protocol/plugin docs, contract tests, conflict refresh, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The original async requireApproval/plugin approval feature history makes this the strongest product/API ownership signal among the likely owners.
